The [[T4 turret droid]] was a large, multi-legged [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] from the [[Colicoid Creation Nest/Legends|Colicoid Creation Nest]].

==History==
The T4 was first built several years before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. The primary function of the droid was to act as a mobile defense platform to protect dignitaries who were visiting hostile worlds. During the invasion, many were redeployed to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] to enforce the peace and prevent [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|the queen]] from fleeing. Even though they failed at the last task, they performed well enough to continue being used up to the early stages of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They cost 26940 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new and were restricted to military usage.<ref name="SGtD" />
[[File:WookieeToss.jpg|left|thumb|171x171px|The droids were attacked by a group of resistance members.]]

==Usage==
The T4 was primarily used in defensive positions, and were often found near crossroads or checkpoints. They could be modified to be [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] spotters, listening posts, or patrolling guard droids.<ref name="SGtD" />
